verdict.rationale: Marlin produces AI-generated insights and suggestions inside the product: it compares hypotheses for deep insights, maps causal relationships into structured strategic options, and auto-generates reports and slides. However, all evidence describes autonomous web and primary-source research on a user-supplied topic, not analysis of the user's own data, so the 'from my data' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of ingesting or analyzing user-provided or internal data, interactive in-product suggestions beyond one-shot reports, and independent hands-on corroboration.
